description: Park the session while lobstah work is in flight; wake it the moment something needs attention. Each hook runs `lobstah hook <event>`, which detects the session's role (helm, trap, or neither). The Stop hook is inert unless the directory opts in with a .lobstah-man file (or LOBSTAH_MAN=1) or the session is soaking (lobstah soak). SessionStart announces the session id; SessionEnd stows a soaking session cleanly. PostToolUse runs `lobstah hook post-tool-use`: a soaking session's liveness and activity, throttled, inert elsewhere.

hooks.statusMessage: lobstah park — waiting for the fleet
